description: P2-A (refactor wizard overlay to Modal.tsx) + P2-B (i18n for wizard copy) + P3-A (contextual re-entry nudge on /holder). These three make structural changes: P2-A replaces the wizard shell, P2-B moves all copy into next-intl, P3-A adds a new client component. They are independent of each other in terms of code ownership but are batched into one FEAT because each builds on the stable baseline FEAT-001 establishes, and they are all non-breaking to the step content. FEAT-002 must follow FEAT-001.
steps: Step 1 — P2-A: Modal.tsx integration. Read Modal.tsx props: id, title, onClose, children, className, maxWidth (default '360px'). In OnboardingWizard.tsx: (a) Add `import { Modal } from '@/components/Modal'`. (b) Replace the entire outer overlay `<div className='ob-wizard-overlay' role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label='Onboarding wizard'>` and the inner `<div className='card ob-wizard-card'>` (including its close button) with `<Modal id='onboarding-wizard' title='Setup guide' onClose={dismiss} maxWidth='600px' className='ob-wizard-card'>`. Move all content that was inside the wizard card (StepRail, step header row, step content switch, GuidanceTip, navigation, help link) into the Modal's children. (c) Remove the standalone close button `<button ... aria-label='Skip onboarding'>` (Modal.tsx provides its own). (d) Keep the ob-wizard-card className on the Modal's className prop so the responsive max-height CSS from globals.css still applies (Modal passes className to the inner dialog div). Note: Modal.tsx renders `<div className='modal-overlay'>` with its own backdrop — the ob-wizard-overlay class is no longer needed on an outer wrapper. Files: frontend/components/OnboardingWizard.tsx

Step 3 — P2-B: Mirror onboarding namespace in es.json. Add the same 'onboarding' key structure to frontend/public/locales/es.json with Spanish translations. The structure (leaf keys) must be identical to en.json — every key that exists in en must exist in es, and no extra keys. This is required by the check-i18n-parity.mjs script. Use reasonable Spanish translations. Files: frontend/public/locales/es.json

Step 4 — P2-B: Update OnboardingWizard.tsx to use useTranslations. Add `import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl'`. In the main `OnboardingWizard` function, add `const t = useTranslations('onboarding')`. Pass `t` down to subcomponents that need it, OR call t() at the OnboardingWizard level and pass resolved strings as props. Decision: resolve strings at the top level and pass as props to keep subcomponents pure. Replace all hardcoded English strings in the wizard: (a) STEP_GUIDANCE references like `guidance.title`, `guidance.summary`, `guidance.tip`, `guidance.railLabel` become `t('steps.{step}.title')` etc. (b) TRUST_STATUS_GUIDANCE label/message values become `t('trust.{status}.label')` / `t('trust.{status}.message')`. (c) Button labels ('Next', 'Back', 'Skip tour', 'Get started', etc.) become `t('buttons.next')` etc. (d) The StepRail aria-label and GuidanceTip text become `t(...)` calls. (e) The hardcoded 'step X of N' text becomes `t('nav.stepOf', { current: stepIndex + 1, total: ONBOARDING_STEPS.length })`. Keep STEP_GUIDANCE in onboarding-guidance.ts as the source-of-truth for TypeScript types and the canProceed/blockedReason/trustChecklist logic — those functions are not touched. Note: TRUST_STATUS_GUIDANCE.severity values and blockedReason() strings from onboarding-guidance.ts are still used directly (they're logic, not display copy). Files: frontend/components/OnboardingWizard.tsx

Step 5 — P3-A: Add ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED storage key. In frontend/lib/storage-keys.ts, add to the STORAGE_KEYS object: `ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED: 'stellarcred:onboarding-nudge-dismissed'`. Also add this key to the getAllStorageKeys() array. Files: frontend/lib/storage-keys.ts

Step 6 — P3-A: Create OnboardingNudge component. Create a new file frontend/components/OnboardingNudge.tsx. It must be 'use client'. Import: useOnboarding from '@/lib/onboarding', useWallet from '@/lib/wallet-context', STORAGE_KEYS from '@/lib/storage-keys', useState from 'react', IconX and IconArrowRight from '@tabler/icons-react'. Logic: (a) Call `const { isComplete, currentStep, goToStep } = useOnboarding()` — note: useOnboarding returns `state.completed` as isComplete indirectly; use `state.completed` or check `!isComplete` where isComplete is `mounted && !state.dismissed && !state.completed`. Actually: useOnboarding returns `isVisible` (mounted && !dismissed && !completed). For the nudge we want `!state.completed` regardless of dismissed status. Use `const { state, goToStep, mounted } = useOnboarding()` and check `mounted && !state.completed`. (b) Call `const { address } = useWallet()`. (c) `const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false)`. (d) On mount (useEffect), read `localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED)` and if truthy set dismissed = true. (e) Show condition: `!dismissed && !state.completed && !!address && (ONBOARDING_STEPS.indexOf(currentStep) <= 4)` — i.e., user is on generate-proof step (index 4) or earlier. (f) Dismiss handler: set dismissed = true, write `localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED, '1')`. (g) Continue handler: calls `goToStep(4)`. Render: a `<div role='status' className='card row between'` styled with warning border (rgba(232,176,75,0.3)) and background (rgba(232,176,75,0.07)), with: the message text, a 'Continue setup' button (btn btn-primary btn-sm, calls goToStep(4)), and a dismiss × button (btn btn-ghost btn-sm, calls dismiss handler). Return null if show condition is false or !mounted. Files: frontend/components/OnboardingNudge.tsx (new file)

Step 7 — P3-A: Mount OnboardingNudge in HolderPageClient.tsx. In HolderInner() in frontend/app/holder/HolderPageClient.tsx, import OnboardingNudge. Render `<OnboardingNudge />` just above the `<ConfigBanner />` line (near the top of the list view, always visible when condition is met regardless of view.kind). Files: frontend/app/holder/HolderPageClient.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd frontend && pnpm test` passes all tests
Running `cd frontend && pnpm check:i18n` passes — en.json and es.json have identical leaf key sets under the new 'onboarding' namespace
OnboardingWizard renders via Modal.tsx — the wizard's own overlay div is gone, Modal.tsx's focus trap and Escape handler are active
All wizard copy is driven by useTranslations('onboarding') — no hardcoded English strings remain in the wizard
STEP_GUIDANCE in onboarding-guidance.ts is unchanged (types and logic still work); the unit tests still pass
OnboardingNudge renders on /holder when wallet is connected, onboarding is incomplete, and step index <= 4
Clicking 'Continue setup' opens the wizard at the generate-proof step (index 4)
Clicking × on the nudge sets localStorage 'stellarcred:onboarding-nudge-dismissed' and hides the banner
STORAGE_KEYS.ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED is registered in storage-keys.ts and returned by getAllStorageKeys()
verification: cd frontend && pnpm test — all tests pass
cd frontend && pnpm check:i18n — i18n parity passes
cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit — no TypeScript errors
findings: P2-A: Replaced ob-wizard-overlay div with Modal.tsx (id=onboarding-wizard, maxWidth=600px, className=ob-wizard-card). Modal provides focus trap, Escape handler, and backdrop. P2-B: Added onboarding namespace to en.json and es.json (identical leaf key structure). OnboardingWizard now uses useTranslations('onboarding') with a loose OT type alias to allow dynamic template-literal key lookups without TS errors. STEP_GUIDANCE preserved for canProceed/blockedReason/trustChecklist logic. P3-A: OnboardingNudge.tsx created (use client, self-gating, persistent dismiss via STORAGE_KEYS.ONBOARDING_NUDGE_DISMISSED). Mounted in HolderInner just above ConfigBanner. Note: pnpm/node not on PATH in agent shell; verification commands could not be run from this environment. Code is structurally sound and follows all patterns from context.json and plan.md.
